title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping to build balanced and nutritious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following are some international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy:
* Oats: Oats are a rich source of fiber and iron, supporting digestive health and preventing anemia.
* Greek yogurt: Greek yogurt contains high amounts of protein and calcium, supporting bone and tooth health.
* Lentils: Lentils are a rich source of fiber, protein, and iron, supporting digestive health and preventing anemia.
* Low-mercury salmon: Salmon is a rich source of omega-3 fatty acids, supporting brain and eye development in the baby.
* Eggs: Eggs are a rich source of protein and vitamins, supporting overall health and well-being.
* Leafy greens and citrus: Leafy greens and citrus fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting immune function and preventing illness.

## Building Balanced Meals for Pregnancy
To build balanced and nutritious meals for pregnancy, expectant mothers can combine international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods. Here are some suggestions:
* Breakfast: Oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
* Lunch: Rice with lentils, leafy greens, and low-mercury salmon.
* Dinner: Scrambled eggs with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
Expectant mothers need to consider food safety when preparing and consuming international pantry staples. Here are some considerations:
* Choose fresh and clean ingredients.
* Wash hands before preparing and consuming food.
* Cook food thoroughly before consumption.
* Avoid foods that can cause food poisoning, such as sushi and sashimi.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. International pantry staples, such as oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus, can help build balanced and nutritious meals. Expectant mothers should consider food safety when preparing and consuming these foods.
